There’s a quiet all out war for the future of our country. Let us not misdirect our precious resources.

I do not believe I lost due to fraudulent votes, mail-in ballots, hacking, or mistabulated results. I respect those who want to make sure, but I won’t be requesting a recount.

Why was turnout huge?

✅Local elections happened this year… 2022 was the last time.

✅As KY trends red, focus shifts to primary, not general.

✅Hotly contested Senate race happened this year… 2014 was the last time.

✅This race cost 60 times more than my average primary.

This post is from my Legislative Director, Raphael. He is the original author of the Epstein Files Transparency Act. He was offered twice his salary to leave my office and declined.

The staff of @RepRoKhanna and @RepMcGovern also made tremendous contributions to the legislation.


Raphael 🇺🇸 ☨ (@Deadswan65)

I’m incredibly privileged and honored to serve under who I believe to be the greatest man in American politics since the days of our Founders, @RepThomasMassie @MassieforKY.

The U.S. should NOT use propaganda on our citizens, but that prohibition was lifted in 2013!

Thank you @RepDavidRouzer for cosponsoring HR 5704 to repeal the 2013 Smith-Mundt Modernization Act.

No one should have to beg the government to exercise a constitutionally protected right anywhere in the country.  

Thank you @AustinScottGA08 for cosponsoring HR 645, the National Constitutional Carry Act.

I proudly stood in the way of your AI-data center amendment to the Big Beautiful Bill that would have given those companies immunity from the law. In fact, @mtgreenee and I got it stripped from the bill. Did your big tech cronies still let you cash their checks after you failed?

I will be @Willie700WLW's guest at 12:06 PM today. Tune in to @700WLW!

Tune in!

This Week (@ThisWeekABC)

SUNDAY: Ahead of Kentucky’s primary Tuesday, George Stephanopoulos interviews @RepThomasMassie, who is fending off a Trump-endorsed challenger in what has become the most expensive House primary in U.S. history. @ThisWeekABC bit.ly/3R8f02d





— https://nitter.net/ThisWeekABC/status/2055748645467697520#m

Good Morning, KY-04 voters!

Today, Saturday 5/16, is the last day to vote early before Election Day, Tuesday, 5/19.

Find your polling place and times at this link: massie.house.gov/services/vo…

This week, I met with representatives of @KPMAstaff.

We discussed the necessity, efficiency, and clean-burning properties of petroleum-based heating oil. They also expressed concern that small businesses in the energy industry are being negatively affected by credit card fees.

4th District Voters:

Early voting for KY primaries continues today, Friday, 5/15, and Saturday, 5/16.

Cast your vote early to beat the lines or if you can't make it out on Election Day, Tuesday, 5/19.

Find your polling location and hours:
massie.house.gov/services/vo…
I will be @RobFinnertyUSA's guest on NEWSMAX at 8:45 PM ET. Tune into "Finnerty" to watch!

This week, I met with Dr. Ryan Quarles, President of @KCTCS, the Kentucky Community and Technical College System.

He shared great news -- enrollment in Kentucky’s community and technical colleges is up by 10,000 students this year, and there is a growing interest in the trades.

We need more transparency in the foreign interest lobbying on Capitol Hill. That’s why I introduced the Americans Insist on Political Agent Clarity Act today.
